picks.name: Space Ghost
picks.source_note: Already in your library (House playlist, "Sea Snake Island"/"Endless Light"). First solo album since 2022, on his own Peace World Records.
picks.bio: "Back From Reality" (October 9, 2026, Peace World Records) is Space Ghost's first solo album since 2022 -- steeped in late-'90s/early-2000s PS2-era ambient and electronic nostalgia, written over five years while balancing a day job with music. Tracks include "System Reset" and the downtempo title cut.
picks.why_listen: A warm, nostalgic ambient/downtempo detour from an artist already in your library -- strong material for intros, warmups, or a late-night wind-down stretch.
